The three points tell it, but you're right it's a bit implicit. My point is: if something (DBR/RBD) reacts from a zone that isn't it's target, it's for a reason. Later on, that target will be reached, and the first reaction will be broken. The only purpose of that is to fool retailers. In your example, the reaction comes from in between two targets, so it was bound to break. Hope it helps.

I use Powerpoint 2016.

About your second example, that's really hard to say! I don't see a proper BSZ setup (at least on that scale), i don't see any valid PA showing the way, and i don't know what barrier your zone broke so that you marked it that way so you've to help us a bit there! What instrument is that?

posts.t: yes a zone can still be important days, week, or even years later. A DBR/RBD is a change of mind on the value. For instance with a RBD price was up but stalled and eventually dropped. The market changed its mind on the price. So when it's broken of course it's an important decision too.

posts.t:
@EnigmaFX: your charts looks very good. Maybe this is the reason nobody stopped and gave you a feedback:)

Keep going with great work:) What can I say (from my own experience): after some time working on that exercise, do next: choose the best looking RBD/DBRs, and observe what happened if they keep price more than once. When they break observe what price is doing next:) Also don't forget to check what happened with the price if your RBD/DBR is ignored (engulfed by pole).

There are some RBD/DBR which are far more important than others. You will understand in the future why it is happening.

EDIT: you can take a look at AK's journal and see how you can connect RBD/DBR with QMs: readthemarket.com/index.php/en/forum/jou...rnal?start=400#72553

Best, Chris

@EnigmaFX: چارت‌هایت خیلی خوب به نظر می‌رسند. شاید این دلیل باشد که هیچ‌کس نایستاد و به تو فیدبک بدهد:)

با کار عالی ادامه بده:) چه بگویم (از تجربهٔ خودم): بعد از مدتی کار روی آن تمرین، این کار را بکن: بهترین و به‌ظاهر RBD/DBR‌ها را انتخاب کن، و ببین اگر قیمت را بیش از یک بار نگه دارند چه اتفاقی می‌افتد. وقتی می‌شکنند ببین قیمت بعد چه می‌کند:) همچنین فراموش نکن ببینی اگر RBD/DBR تو نادیده گرفته شود (با دکل اینگالف شود) قیمت چه می‌کند.

بعضی RBD/DBR خیلی مهم‌تر از بقیه هستند. در آینده خواهی فهمید چرا این اتفاق می‌افتد.

ویرایش: می‌توانی به ژورنال AK نگاه کنی و ببینی چطور می‌توانی RBD/DBR را با QM‌ها مرتبط کنی: readthemarket.com/index.php/en/forum/jou...rnal?start=400#72553

بهترین، Chris

posts.t:
Hello,

DHAVAL2193 wrote: are all caps are trade-able?

It is your job to answer this question:) But how do you think? If all caps would be tradeable, then everybody would be trade them. So who would be on the other side of the market? Nobody:) Many caps are created to be faked in the future. Some of them will be ignored one or more times and price will react on it later.

DHAVAL2193 wrote: how can we identify that which cap is important one?

One of the most important answer you must work on:)

DHAVAL2193 wrote: is any relation between CAPS and S/D?

Caps are RBD/DBR.
